actions: Picked the source window that loops best between 24 and 64 frames: start frame 11, 26 frames (138.5 BPM for 2 beats), seam cost 0.222 m.
Mapped the source joints onto the Mixamo bones of the shipped assets/skaters/nia/skater.glb by the change of world rotation from the rest pose. The toe bone stays at rest (rigid skate boot).
Closed the loop seam and retimed the window to 48 frames at 30 fps (2 clip beats).
Leg IK holds the wheels on the ground. The hips go down by up to 0.0019 m where the leg cannot reach the ground. Baked to plain bone keys.
